biography: Peter McEneaney is an Executive Vice President at global real estate firm, 800 Fulton, overseeing acquisitions, development, asset management, and construction across the company’s US portfolio. His primary responsibilities include leading 800 Fulton’s continuous growth across all asset classes and project types including retail, office, industrial, life science, hotel, and residential. Currently, McEneaney is leading the execution of office, industrial, life science, and retail projects across the US.Prior to joining 800 Fulton in 2013, he began his career as a Project Manager working with Cauldwell Wingate where he was responsible for construction project management. He holds a Master of Science degree in Real Estate Finance from NYU Schack Institute of Real Estate.
